title: dactylorhiza × megapolitana
intro: Dactylorhiza × megapolitana, commonly known as the Berlin dactylorhiza, is a hybrid orchid species that belongs to the Dactylorhiza genus. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help in reducing symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza × megapolitana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which may contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's medicinal properties and its potential therapeutic applications.
